title: Back at the Lectern: Recordings, Speeches and AI
description: Back in Beijing after the National Day holiday, Steven talks about new classroom rules: students must record their group discussions and give two-minute talks instead of reading from their phones. He also covers the privacy costs of AI agents, his four-terminal editing setup, a possible October stock market drop and Facebook Muse.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Quick overview

sentences.zh: 国庆假期结束了，史蒂文回到北京，也回到了讲台。
sentences.en: The National Day holiday is over, and Steven is back in Beijing and back at the lectern.

sentences.zh: 这期周五节目主要聊教学：一次推迟的小测验，“小组讨论必须录音”的新规定，还有让学生别再对着手机念稿的计划。
sentences.en: This Friday episode is mainly about teaching: a postponed quiz, a new rule that "group discussions must be recorded," and a plan to stop students from reading scripts off their phones.

sentences.zh: 他还聊到没练成的硬拉、让AI接管电脑要付出的隐私代价，以及他同时开着的四个终端窗口。
sentences.en: He also talks about the deadlift he didn't manage to master, the privacy cost of letting AI take over your computer, and the four terminal windows he keeps open at the same time.

sentences.zh: 最后，他谈到十月股市可能出现的“意外”，说了说对Facebook Muse的看法，还请大家试听了AI配音。
sentences.en: Finally, he discusses a possible "surprise" in the stock market in October, shares his thoughts on Facebook Muse, and invites everyone to listen to some AI voiceovers.

sentences.zh: 重返课堂
sentences.en: Back in the Classroom

sentences.zh: 十月一日到八日放假，今天的三节课是他一个半星期来第一次上课。
sentences.en: There was a holiday from October 1st to 8th, so today's three classes were his first in a week and a half.

sentences.zh: 一位同事（他觉得对方是组长）说今天要考课文小测验，他特意把测验做进了PPT，结果对方又改到了下周。
sentences.en: A colleague (whom he thinks is the team leader) said there would be a quiz on the text today, so he made a point of putting the quiz into his PPT, but then the colleague moved it to next week.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文说这位同事回消息很慢，大概不太想“罩着他”，当然也可能只是太忙。
sentences.en: Steven says this colleague is slow to reply to messages and probably doesn't really want to "have his back," though of course they might just be too busy.

sentences.zh: 别的老师爱用Kahoot和Padlet，他只试过一次Kahoot，就碰上了人数上限。
sentences.en: Other teachers love using Kahoot and Padlet; he has only tried Kahoot once, and he hit the player limit.

sentences.zh: 他想少依赖科技，也坦白自己以前上课的套路太单一，打算以后每三到五周换一次。
sentences.en: He wants to rely less on technology, and admits that his teaching routine used to be too monotonous, so he plans to change it every three to five weeks from now on.

sentences.zh: 要录音，要演讲，不准聊篮球
sentences.en: Recordings, speeches, and no talking about basketball

sentences.zh: 组长的课件里，口语练习只有“无聊的小组讨论”。
sentences.en: In the team leader's course materials, the only speaking practice was "boring small-group discussions."

sentences.zh: 第一节课，学生把讨论写成了文档，一看就是在敷衍了事。
sentences.en: In the first class, the students turned the discussion into a written document; you could tell at a glance they were just going through the motions.

sentences.zh: 第二节课他改了规矩：每个人都得开口，用手机把对话录下来，再转成文字发给他。
sentences.en: In the second class he changed the rules: everyone had to speak, record the conversation on their phone, then convert it to text and send it to him.

sentences.zh: 他觉得好笑：“你们什么都用AI，却不会看转录文字。”
sentences.en: He found it funny: "You use AI for everything, yet you can't read a transcript."

sentences.zh: 今天他没做破冰活动，课堂明显没那么有活力。
sentences.en: Today he didn't do an icebreaker, and the class was noticeably less lively.

sentences.zh: 作业是个人演讲：话题自选，讲两分钟，配三页幻灯片，每节课两人上台，算课堂参与分。
sentences.en: The assignment is an individual presentation: choose your own topic, speak for two minutes with three slides; two people present each class, and it counts toward class participation.

sentences.zh: 篮球话题一律不准讲：“不要库里，不要詹姆斯……太老套了，抱歉。”
sentences.en: Basketball topics are banned across the board: "No Curry, no James... it's too cliché, sorry."

sentences.zh: 不断创新的循环
sentences.en: A cycle of constant innovation

sentences.zh: 他允许学生在课上用AI，是因为考试不让用：写作考试要纸笔作答，口语考试是四个学生不带任何设备，坐在他面前考。
sentences.en: He lets students use AI in class because they can't use it in exams: the writing exam is done with pen and paper, and for the speaking exam, four students sit in front of him with no devices at all.

sentences.zh: “要是你说话像机器人……兄弟，分数会说明一切。友谊就是在这儿破裂的。”
sentences.en: "If you talk like a robot... bro, the grade will say it all. That's where friendships break."

sentences.zh: 接下来的计划：
sentences.en: Next steps:

sentences.zh: 学生定评分标准： 各组先用AI研究一场好演讲需要哪些要素，再一起商定评分标准。
sentences.en: Students set the rubric: each group first uses AI to research what makes a good presentation, then they agree on the grading criteria together.

sentences.zh: 手绘幻灯片： 每人在纸上画一页幻灯片，只写三到六个词，拍照后拼成一份完整的演示。
sentences.en: Hand-drawn slides: each person draws one slide on paper with only three to six words, then they're photographed and combined into one full presentation.

sentences.zh: 讲解视频： “你知道还有什么也是念稿吗？配音。”
sentences.en: Explainer videos: "You know what else is reading from a script? Voice-over."

sentences.zh: 学校还没给他十二月口语考试的评分标准。
sentences.en: The school still hasn't given him the rubric for the December speaking exam.

sentences.zh: 这门课没有教材，一学期只有五篇文章，用他的话说，“算是Dogme教学法吧”。
sentences.en: The course has no textbook, just five articles a semester; in his words, "it's sort of the Dogme approach."

sentences.zh: 今天没练硬拉
sentences.en: No deadlifts today

sentences.zh: 他早上七点左右才起来活动。
sentences.en: He didn't get up and get moving until around seven in the morning.

sentences.zh: 去健身房要20分钟，九点四十五又要上课，只好在家骑了半小时车，再练了会儿壶铃。
sentences.en: Going to the gym takes 20 minutes, and he had class again at 9:45, so he had no choice but to ride the bike at home for half an hour and then do some kettlebell work.

sentences.zh: 硬拉挪到了周六，到时候再“把健身卡的钱练回本”。
sentences.en: Deadlifts got moved to Saturday, when he'll "work out enough to get his gym membership's money's worth."

sentences.zh: 本地AI的隐患
sentences.en: The hidden risks of local AI

sentences.zh: 史蒂文现在几乎只在终端里用Claude，唯一怀念聊天窗口的地方，是能直接拖放图片。
sentences.en: Steven now uses Claude almost only in the terminal; the one thing he misses about the chat window is being able to drag and drop images directly.

sentences.zh: 他一直刻意不在聊天机器人里输入自己的名字，后来才发现，拖进文件的时候，文件路径也一起交了出去。
sentences.en: He had always deliberately avoided typing his own name into chatbots, only to discover later that when he dragged in files, the file paths were handed over too.

sentences.zh: 更让他担心的是权限。
sentences.en: What worries him even more is permissions.

sentences.zh: Claude Code、ChatGPT Codex和OpenClaw可能会安装你不认识的软件，还能读取任何够得着的文件，甚至包括“那封你从没发给老板的邮件”。
sentences.en: Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex and OpenClaw might install software you don't recognize, and can read any file they can reach — even "that email you never sent to your boss."

sentences.zh: Claude和Codex会把这些数据传回自己的服务器；OpenClaw只有在通过API连接外部服务时才会这样。
sentences.en: Claude and Codex send this data back to their own servers; OpenClaw only does so when it connects to outside services through an API.

sentences.zh: 他的目标是用上完全在自己电脑上运行的AI。
sentences.en: His goal is to use AI that runs entirely on his own computer.

sentences.zh: 四个终端窗口
sentences.en: Four terminal windows

sentences.zh: 女朋友的评价是：“不就是你又在玩电脑嘛。”
sentences.en: His girlfriend's take: "Isn't that just you playing on the computer again?"

sentences.zh: 他的四个窗口分别负责日常聊天、启动转录、整理转录稿和剪辑短片。
sentences.en: His four windows handle everyday chat, starting transcription, cleaning up transcripts, and editing short clips.

sentences.zh: 有了带时间码的JSON转录稿和原始MOV文件，Claude就能剪出成品短片，还能生成Final Cut用的FCPXML文件。
sentences.en: With a timecoded JSON transcript and the original MOV files, Claude can cut a finished short video and also generate an FCPXML file for Final Cut.

sentences.zh: 等竖版视频、字幕和翻译都搞定，他就能停掉每月约30美元的Descript。
sentences.en: Once vertical video, subtitles and translation are all sorted out, he can cancel Descript, which costs about $30 a month.

sentences.zh: 缺点是：“我越来越像个搞自动化的，而不是内容创作者。”
sentences.en: The downside: "I'm becoming more and more of an automation guy rather than a content creator."

sentences.zh: 维护提示词和整套流程很花时间，他正在考虑雇人来做复制粘贴的活。
sentences.en: Maintaining the prompts and the whole workflow takes a lot of time, so he's considering hiring someone to do the copy-and-paste work.

sentences.zh: 十月惊魂？
sentences.en: A scary October?

sentences.zh: 上周他聊过美联储加息，还有布鲁克·萨克雷对十月股市下跌的研究。
sentences.en: Last week he talked about the Fed raising interest rates, and about Brooke Thackray's research on October stock market declines.

sentences.zh: 那以后加拿大银行股一路走低，蒙特利尔银行从九月中旬到现在跌了约10%；摩根大通也从八月的约365美元跌到了330美元左右。
sentences.en: Since then, Canadian bank stocks have kept falling: Bank of Montreal is down about 10% from mid-September to now, and JPMorgan Chase has also dropped from about $365 in August to around $330.

sentences.zh: 十一月有美国中期选举，但他提醒大家别只怪政客：股市已经连涨两年，人人都以为不会跌，“偏偏这时候就跌了”。
sentences.en: There are US midterm elections in November, but he reminded everyone not to blame only the politicians: the market has risen two years in a row and everyone thinks it won't fall, "and that's exactly when it falls."

sentences.zh: 意外可能来自AI，也可能来自政治或地缘局势。
sentences.en: The surprise could come from AI, or it could come from politics or the geopolitical situation.

sentences.zh: 他强调这不是投资建议：“钱是你的，问题也是你的。”
sentences.en: He stressed that this isn't investment advice: "It's your money, and it's your problem."

sentences.zh: 至于俄罗斯据报出现的疫情，他认为不会变成大流行：“刷牙、洗手、吃好、睡够。”
sentences.en: As for the outbreak reportedly appearing in Russia, he doesn't think it will become a pandemic: "Brush your teeth, wash your hands, eat well, get enough sleep."

sentences.zh: Facebook Muse、广告口播和配音试听
sentences.en: Facebook Muse, ad reads, and a voice-over listening test

sentences.zh: 史蒂文说，Muse就是“换了名字的Manus”。
sentences.en: Steven said Muse is just "Manus with a new name."

sentences.zh: Manus起步于北京，后来搬到新加坡，今年被Facebook收购。
sentences.en: Manus started in Beijing, later moved to Singapore, and was acquired by Facebook this year.

sentences.zh: 它做不出他课程要用的MP3，还必须用Facebook或Instagram账号登录：“这就是Facebook 2.0。”
sentences.en: It can't make the MP3s he needs for his courses, and you also have to log in with a Facebook or Instagram account: "This is just Facebook 2.0."

sentences.zh: 他觉得它的隐私风险和其他智能体一样，“你需要它吗？……不，你不需要。”
sentences.en: He thinks its privacy risks are the same as other AI agents': "Do you need it? ... No, you don't."

sentences.zh: 他还打算停用刚又扣了他8美元的Libsyn，把播客搬到Substack。
sentences.en: He also plans to stop using Libsyn, which just charged him another $8, and move his podcast to Substack.

sentences.zh: 节目最后，大家试听了10月8日那期的AI翻译版，配音分别是台湾口音的Anna Su和OpenAI的Onyx。
sentences.en: At the end of the show, everyone listened to the AI-translated version of the October 8 episode, voiced by the Taiwanese-accented Anna Su and OpenAI's Onyx.

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's summary

sentences.zh: 不管是在课堂上还是电脑前，史蒂文都在不停尝试，看看什么管用，再随时调整。
sentences.en: Whether in the classroom or at the computer, Steven keeps experimenting to see what works and adjusts as he goes.

sentences.zh: 他也慢慢明白，每个自动化工具都需要维护，也要付出一些隐私，他得把这些代价和省下的时间放在一起权衡。
sentences.en: He is also gradually realizing that every automation tool needs maintenance and costs some privacy, and he has to weigh those costs against the time it saves.

vocab.en: to do something half-heartedly, just to get it over with
(colloquial) to look out for someone, take someone under one's wing
to answer with pen and paper
(joking) to work out enough to get your money's worth
